_notes: Single source of truth for Part II environment parameters, mirroring part1_gridworld/config/training_config.json. core_env.py / phases.py / obs.py should load this from CONFIG_DIR/arena.json once implemented rather than hardcoding module constants (ARENA_WIDTH/ARENA_HEIGHT/DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS are kept as fallbacks). max_steps was reduced from the original 3000 so a 300k-timestep run sees a usable number of episode terminations (see docs/AUDIT_main.md 5.4). phase_curve and curriculum values feed phases.py::difficulty_for_phase (see its docstring for the ramp schedule). num_active_enemies_max is the normalisation divisor for the num_active_enemies_frac observation feature (docs/AUDIT_main.md 7.4). All values are starting points to be tuned during implementation and reported in report section 4.
